For a **North American hotel with a for-sale branded-residences component**, the practical brand universe is usually concentrated in luxury and lifestyle flags with established residential platforms.

### Most commonly shortlisted

| Segment | Brands commonly considered | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Established luxury leaders** | **Four Seasons, The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Waldorf Astoria, Rosewood, Mandarin Oriental** | Prime urban towers, destination resorts and high-value condominium programs. Four Seasons and Ritz-Carlton are among the sector’s most established names; Four Seasons currently lists more than 40 North American residential locations. ([impacts.savills.com](https://impacts.savills.com/market-trends/living-the-dream-why-branded-residences-are-the-ultimate-designer-homes.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Luxury lifestyle / design-led** | **EDITION, W, The Luxury Collection, Pendry, Andaz, Thompson Hotels, The Standard** | Projects targeting younger or more design-conscious buyers in markets such as Miami, Los Angeles, New York, Nashville and Mexico. Marriott formally offers residential products under EDITION, W and Luxury Collection, while Hyatt’s active residential platform includes Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson, The Standard and Miraval. ([marriottresidences.com](https://marriottresidences.com/luxury_brand/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Traditional luxury and upper-luxury** | **JW Marriott, Conrad, Fairmont, Park Hyatt, InterContinental** | Larger mixed-use developments where global distribution and loyalty-program recognition matter, but residential pricing may not support the highest ultra-luxury flags. ([marriottresidences.com](https://marriottresidences.com/luxury_brand/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Ultra-luxury / low-density** | **Aman, Six Senses, Raffles, Regent, One&Only** | Trophy urban projects, secluded resorts and developments with limited residences, high privacy and very high sales pricing. Aman has or is developing residential projects in New York, Beverly Hills, Miami Beach, Utah, Wyoming, Texas, Mexico and the Caribbean; Six Senses has multiple projects planned across the Americas. ([aman.com](https://www.aman.com/residences?utm_source=openai)) |
| **North American resort specialists** | **Montage, Pendry, Auberge Collection** | Ski, golf, wine-country, coastal and master-planned resort communities. These brands have particularly strong relevance in the United States and Mexico. ([auberge.com](https://auberge.com/resorts/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Broader lifestyle alternatives** | **Kimpton, SLS, Mondrian, SO/, LXR Hotels & Resorts, Curio Collection by Hilton** | Projects requiring a more flexible or market-specific identity, often at somewhat lower residential pricing than the traditional ultra-luxury brands. ([ihg.com](https://www.ihg.com/residences/content/us/en/locations?utm_source=openai)) |

## Typical initial shortlist

For an early-stage feasibility exercise, I would normally begin with:

1. **Four Seasons**
2. **The Ritz-Carlton**
3. **St. Regis**
4. **Waldorf Astoria**
5. **Rosewood**
6. **Mandarin Oriental**
7. **Fairmont**
8. **EDITION or W**
9. **Park Hyatt**
10. **Montage or Pendry**
11. **Auberge Collection**
12. **Aman, Six Senses or Raffles** for an exceptional ultra-luxury site

## How the shortlist changes by project type

- **Major urban luxury tower:** Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Waldorf Astoria, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood, EDITION.
- **Miami or lifestyle-oriented urban project:** EDITION, W, Pendry, SLS, Andaz, Thompson, The Standard.
- **Ski or mountain resort:** Four Seasons, Montage, Pendry, Auberge, Waldorf Astoria, Ritz-Carlton.
- **Beach/golf resort in Mexico or the Caribbean:** Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Rosewood, Auberge, One&Only, Aman, Six Senses, Fairmont.
- **Luxury project with somewhat broader pricing:** JW Marriott, Conrad, Fairmont, InterContinental, Kimpton or selected Hilton collection brands.

The best brand is ultimately driven by **achievable hotel ADR, residential price per square foot, number and mix of residences, buyer profile, rental-program structure, brand territory availability, management economics and whether the residences share hotel amenities or have separate facilities**. A prestigious flag can improve sales velocity and pricing, but its design standards, residential fees and operating requirements can also materially increase development costs.
